Questions & answers

Questions about
talent-share.

A practical guide to learning, teaching, and finding your way around talent-share.

17 answers

What is talent-share?

talent-share is a marketplace for live learning. You can find a program, read about the provider, book a date, and attend online inside the app or in person. The same account can be used to learn and, after an approved application, to teach.

Are these live programs or recorded videos?

Programs are taught live, either online or in person. Online sessions run in talent-share’s video room, with camera, microphone, screen sharing, and session chat. Providers may also share supporting resources, including videos, in the program’s file library.

Do I need an account to look at a program?

You can read public program pages before signing in. Booking requires an account. The classroom, program files, announcements, and program discussion are available to confirmed seekers and the provider.

How do I know whether a program is right for me?

Check its level, learning outcomes, requirements, materials, delivery mode, and full schedule. Read the provider’s profile and any reviews available. You can also message the provider from the program if you need to clarify something before booking.

How much does a program cost?

Each provider sets the program price. Checkout shows the program price and service fee separately, along with the total, before you pay. Your receipt uses the same breakdown. Check the selected program for its current price.

Can I book just one date in a repeating program?

When a program is offered on several start dates, you book the date selected in the booking card. Check the full schedule for that selection: a single booking may include multiple sessions. Other start dates are separate bookings.

Where do I join an online program?

Sign in and open your program’s schedule. Confirmed seekers can join from 15 minutes before the session starts. The video room is inside talent-share, so you do not need a separate meeting app.

What happens between sessions?

You can read provider announcements, join the program discussion, send private program-linked messages, and download resources the provider has shared. Those conversations and files stay with the program.

How are providers reviewed?

People applying to teach submit a profile with information such as their experience, education, skills, languages, and relevant links. talent-share reviews the application before approval. Read the public profile to assess whether a provider’s background fits what you want to learn.

Who can leave a review?

A seeker with a completed enrollment can leave a rating and written review. Providers can reply publicly. Reviews appear with the program and provider, helping you understand the experiences people chose to share.

Can I cancel a booking?

You can request a cancellation within 24 hours of enrolling if the first session is still at least 24 hours away. Requests are subject to platform approval. Check the current policy in the app before booking and contact support if you need help.

Can I teach and learn with the same account?

Yes. You can learn with your account and apply to become a provider from it. After approval, your teaching and learning activity have their own dashboard views under the same login.

What do I need to apply to teach?

Prepare a profile photo, bio, professional background, skills, and the talents you want to share. Add relevant education, certifications, teaching experience, languages, and links. The application shows required information that is missing before you submit it for review.

Can I create a program without using AI?

Yes. You can fill in the program details yourself. If you use the writing assistant, start with a short description of your idea, then check and edit the suggested listing before publishing. You choose the final content, schedule, price, and capacity.

How do providers manage their programs?

The provider dashboard brings together drafts and published programs, seeker lists, the teaching calendar, program messages, and reports. Providers can see enrollment and earnings information and export reports for a selected date range.

Can I use talent-share on my phone?

talent-share has a responsive website for phones, tablets, and computers. You can open the app in your browser to browse programs, manage your account, and access your enrolled programs. Use a device and connection suited to the session you are attending.

What happens if the provider cancels?

If the provider cancels the program, seekers receive a full refund to the original payment method. Refunds usually appear in 5 to 10 business days. talent-share notifies you in the app and by email.
